resolvedQuestions: What does the current Pi Remote implementation already support, and where are the highest-value parity gaps?
How should phone-first model and effort controls be presented and mapped to Pi RPC state safely?
How should typed commands and a prominent read-only plan-mode toggle work without weakening transport or foreground-authority controls?
Which comparative mobile chat patterns materially improve the transcript and composer?
What phased implementation plan best fits the current stack?

keyFindings.title: Typed transcript blocks are the correct foundation
keyFindings.summary: Restyle and group typed blocks instead of flattening execution semantics.

keyFindings.title: Requested controls require a typed relay control plane
keyFindings.summary: No current model, effort, command, or plan-mode state/API exists in the web client.

keyFindings.title: Composer needs a mobile-first interaction contract
keyFindings.summary: Autosizing, explicit touch send, context chips, pending state, and safe quick actions are absent.

keyFindings.title: Streaming needs follow-state and jump-to-latest
keyFindings.summary: Virtualization has no reader-position-aware live edge.

keyFindings.title: Pi RPC already supports model selection
keyFindings.summary: Use get_state/get_available_models/set_model with acknowledgement and reconciliation.

keyFindings.title: Thinking levels are exact and model-dependent
keyFindings.summary: Render get_available_thinking_levels and refresh after model changes.

keyFindings.title: Keep runtime settings visible near the composer
keyFindings.summary: Persistent model and effort chips open host-backed bottom sheets.

keyFindings.title: Extend Pi Remote protocol before UI wiring
keyFindings.summary: Current types and guards reject Pi model/thinking commands.

keyFindings.title: Use Pi get_commands as the catalog source
keyFindings.summary: Project a redacted, policy-filtered live command inventory to the PWA.

keyFindings.title: Extension commands require prompt routing
keyFindings.summary: Classify commands and preserve Pi's immediate extension-command semantics.

keyFindings.title: Plan mode is host-enforced
keyFindings.summary: Use the extension's tool restrictions and /plan toggle, not local prompt decoration.

keyFindings.title: Add authoritative plan-state projection
keyFindings.summary: Reconcile Build, Plan, and executing-plan state after toggle and reconnect.

keyFindings.title: Group typed blocks by conversational turn
keyFindings.summary: User bubble and borderless assistant prose lead; execution evidence nests beneath.

keyFindings.title: Use reader-position-aware live following
keyFindings.summary: Freeze review position and expose N new / Jump to latest.

keyFindings.title: Build an autosizing mobile control dock
keyFindings.summary: Explicit touch dispatch, context row, consolidated command affordance, and Send/Steer/Stop state.

keyFindings.title: Name the current streaming phase
keyFindings.summary: Stable elapsed-time state replaces generic dot activity and collapses on settlement.

keyFindings.title: Add one authoritative RuntimeStateDto
keyFindings.summary: All control chips and mode labels reconcile against a revisioned relay projection.

keyFindings.title: Use a narrow ticketed runtime.control union
keyFindings.summary: Validate live catalogs and stale revisions; never expose generic RPC passthrough.

keyFindings.title: Ship authority before controls before transcript polish
keyFindings.summary: Protocol/service harness, control dock, turn grouping, then physical-iPhone QA.

keyFindings.title: Prove UX and authority together
keyFindings.summary: Host-state, plan enforcement, safe commands, composer, live-edge, accessibility, and regression checks.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Flatten typed blocks into generic chat bubbles
Represent host controls as local-only preferences

ruledOutDirections.reason: Hide or stale live Pi state.
Can lie after command failure or reconciliation.
Obscures exact Pi levels and model capability differences.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Static or unfiltered client command catalog
ruledOutDirections.reason: Drifts from Pi and can expose privileged commands or host paths.
Removes the argument and safety review point.
Does not enforce read-only tools or reconcile after reconnect.
Breaks the one-live-session model; /plan is the in-session toggle.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Equal card treatment for every block
ruledOutDirections.reason: Destroys conversational hierarchy and overweights low-signal execution detail.
Destroys review position and creates visual churn.
Causes accidental submission and blocks natural multiline input.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Permanent composer icon row or decorative rebrand
ruledOutDirections.reason: Crowds the phone surface and conflicts with restrained one-accent styling.
Weakens validation and exposes a broader remote execution surface.
Creates UI that can lie about host state.
RPC mode cannot rely on ctx.ui.select for phone interaction.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Rewrite transcript storage for visual grouping
ruledOutDirections.reason: A derived turn view preserves stable typed projection and limits blast radius.
